page.overview:
What is Lilycove City?

Lilycove City is a location introduced in Generation III.

Lilycove City is a city located in the northeastern part of the Hoenn region, connected by Route 124 in the east and Route 121 in the west. However, the path to Route 124 is blocked by several Wailmers until the player character completes the Team Magma Hideout or Team Aqua Hideout at the northeast of Lilycove City.

Besides the villain hideout, Lilycove City has a variety of visitable areas. There is a Contest Hall, which hosts Master Rank Pokémon Contests in and all Contests in . To the east of the Contest Hall is Cove Lily Motel, which is empty until after Team Magma and Team Aqua flees Lilycove City, with staff members of Game Freak moving in by the time the player becomes the Pokémon Champion. To the north is the Lilycove Museum, which has art presented on display. To the east of the Lilycove Museum is the Lilycove Department Store, the largest store of the Hoenn region. To the east of the Lilycove Department Store is the home of the only Move Deleter in the Hoenn region, and to the south is the usual Pokémon Center, which is otherwise normal but has the Pokémon Center Ladies trio in that give rewards by record mixing with other players. To the southeast of the Move Deleter's House is the Pokémon Trainer Fan Club, where fans discuss popular Pokémon Trainers, including the player once they enter the Hall of Fame. At the southwest of Lilycove City is the Lilycove City Harbor, where the player can embark on the S.S. Tidal to travel to Slateport City, as well as the Battle Frontier in .

After the events at Seafloor Cavern, Lilycove City is affected by extremely harsh sunlight (in and ) or heavy rain (in and ) until the player battles Kyogre or Groudon at the Cave of Origin in Sootopolis City. The music is also replaced with the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=q4Vq0Fmz46s flood theme] or the [https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=Bxwfl_-P2gI drought theme] while the respective weather is in effect, like with Mossdeep City, Sootopolis City, and Routes 124 through 131.
